issue.standard_remedy: Qualify a second source and shift volume
issue.summary: High-risk supplier (score 45.4) holds 13% of a category

plan.diagnosis: Neptune Energy AG represents USD 2,159,071 in spend (13.4% category share) with elevated risk profile: risk score 45.4, low ESG score of 35, resiliency score of only 52, 2 adverse media events in 12 months, and failure class 1. Concentration in a single high-risk supplier exposes the category to supply disruption and compliance risk.

remedy_steps.step: Issue RFI to pre-qualified alternative suppliers in Germany and neighboring markets to identify 2-3 backup sources capable of absorbing 50% of Neptune Energy AG volume
Conduct supplier audits (financial, ESG, operational resiliency) on top 2 RFI respondents and negotiate commercial terms targeting 10-15% cost parity with Neptune Energy AG
Award 30-40% of current Neptune Energy AG volume (USD 650,000-860,000) to selected secondary supplier(s) via split-award strategy
Implement enhanced monitoring for Neptune Energy AG: monthly risk score review, quarterly business continuity assessment, and escalation protocol for adverse media or ESG incidents
Renegotiate Neptune Energy AG contract to include improved SLA penalties, force majeure clarity, and ESG improvement commitments as condition for retained 60-70% volume

plan.expected_impact: Reduce supplier concentration risk by 30-40% (USD 650,000-860,000 volume diversified), lower category weighted-average risk score by 8-12 points, and establish supply continuity protection for USD 2,159,071 annual spend.
kpis: Category HHI (Herfindahl-Hirschman Index) reduction from current concentration
Neptune Energy AG category share reduced from 13.4% to below 9%
Category weighted-average supplier risk score improvement to below 40
Secondary source operational and delivering within 6 months
Zero supply disruptions attributable to Neptune Energy AG over next 12 months
risks: Alternative suppliers may demand 10-20% price premium for smaller initial volumes, increasing category cost
Transition period may strain Neptune Energy AG relationship and trigger service degradation
Secondary source qualification timeline may extend beyond 10 weeks if technical certifications or tooling required
Neptune Energy AG ESG score of 35 and adverse media events may trigger mandatory exclusion under corporate sustainability policy before dual-source established
Limited supplier base in specialized category may yield insufficient RFI responses
erp_actions: SAP: Update vendor master LFA1 for Neptune Energy AG with risk flag and spending limit; add warning message in LFM1 purchasing org data
SAP: Create source list entries (ME01) for new secondary supplier(s) with quota arrangement splitting volume 60/40 or 70/30
Oracle EBS: Set supplier risk classification to 'High' in Supplier Portal and enable enhanced approval workflow for POs exceeding USD 50,000
Coupa: Add Neptune Energy AG to restricted supplier list with mandatory risk acknowledgment and two-level approval for new requisitions
All ERPs: Update payment terms for Neptune Energy AG to Net 60 (from Net 45/30) to improve working capital position and reduce exposure
Dynamics 365 & NetSuite: Configure automated alerts when Neptune Energy AG spend exceeds USD 150,000 per month threshold
